lines.text: {leader} wins again, and the gap to {trailer} just got a little wider!
Another season, another win for {leader}, and the horizon keeps sliding away from {trailer}.
Healthy before, that lead. Now it is something much more serious, and {winnerClub} know it!
Pulling clear now, {leader}, and the rear lights are getting smaller for {trailer}!
You wonder how {trailer} responds to this. {leader} has gone and made a big lead bigger.
{winnerClub} again, and the lead grows. The chasing pack is a pack of one now.
Gone is the breathing room for {trailer}. In its place, a stretch of road with {leader} far out front!
Grip tightening, nerves steady, and {leader} puts another season in the bank.
This is how leads are built. Quietly, calmly, and one winning season after another!
Season {season} goes to {winnerClub}, and the Showdown tilts a little further their way.
{trailer} needed an answer and {leader} supplied another question instead!
There is a lead, and then there is a lead that makes the other dugout go quiet. {leader} has the second kind.
Hear that? That is the sound of {loserClub} running out of road!
Tight at the top a while ago. Rather less tight now, thanks to {leader}!
What does {trailer} do now? {leader} has won again, and the lead is stretching out!
The gap now stands at {margin}, and {leader} is not looking back!
{leader} extends the advantage to {margin}, and that is a lot of daylight!
Daylight, that is what {leader} has found. Daylight and a lead of {margin}!
Take a long look at the gap. It is {margin} now, and it did not shrink on {leader}'s watch!
{leader} adds another winning season, and the lead to {trailer} reads {margin} now.
A lead of {margin} for {winnerClub}, and the nearest rival is squinting at the horizon!
It is {margin} between them, and {leader} is still pushing for more!
Out in front by {margin}, and every season adds another brick to the wall for {leader}.
{trailer} cut the deficit once. {leader} has cut that idea off at the knees.
You cannot win a Showdown in one season, but {leader} is making a fine case for trying!
The longer this goes, the more it looks like {leader}'s Showdown. {trailer} has work to do.
Steady hands at the wheel, {leader}, and the road ahead is clear!
Keep an eye on {winnerClub}, because they are not slowing down and the gap is not closing!
{trailer} gave chase, but {leader} simply found another gear and pulled away.
Winning once is good. Winning again, and stretching the lead, is how legends start talking about you!
Here is the thing about a lead: it takes a long time to build and a short time to lose, and {leader} is building.
Bit by bit, season by season, {winnerClub} are turning a lead into a lock!
Make no mistake, {trailer}, this is a statement from {leader}.
The scoreboard of the Showdown is leaning hard to one side, and it is {leader}'s side!
Another season banked, another notch up the ladder, and {leader} is a long way clear of {trailer}!
Cruising altitude for {leader}. Turbulence, for {trailer}.
{leader} just made the chase a lot harder. Uphill, and into the wind for {trailer}!
Calm, clinical, and out of sight. That is {winnerClub} this season!
Feel that shift? The lead is no longer a lead. It is becoming a gap {trailer} must fix.
Season after season, {leader} keeps finding ways to win, and the cushion keeps getting plumper!
Not a flicker of doubt from {winner}, and not a lot of hope left for {loserClub} to hang on to!
The work of a manager who will not let the foot off the pedal. {leader} wins, and wins again!
A comfortable lead is no place to rest, and {leader} is not resting.
Slowly and surely, the drawbridge goes up, and {leader} is on the safe side of it!
Pressure from behind? Not for {leader}, who has stretched the lead and the smile!
It is {winnerClub} in front, and in front again, and in front by a mile compared to where it began!
You hear it all the time, no lead is safe. {leader} is trying hard to prove that wrong.
Winning breeds winning, and {leader} has caught the habit!
Oh, that is a gap {trailer} will feel in the dugout tonight.
Now {trailer} must find something special, because {leader} has taken another step clear!
Fortune smiles on the brave, and {leader} has been very brave!
Everything {trailer} builds, {leader} seems to top. That is the story of this Showdown right now.
Unstoppable? Not quite. But {leader} is making it look an awful lot like it!
What a position {leader} is in. Further clear, and still hungry!
Every season {leader} wins, the chasing job for {trailer} gets taller.
That was the sort of season that adds a zero to the confidence. The lead is bigger, and so is {winner}'s grin.
They may call it a Showdown, but {leader} is making it look like a stroll.
A lead is a lovely thing, and {leader} has just made theirs lovelier still!
Round after round, {winnerClub} keep winning, and the lead grows with the applause!
Out ahead, further out ahead, and still going. That is {leader} all over!
Hats off to {leader}, who just moved the goalposts for the chase!
Time is running, and each winning season for {leader} takes a bit more of it from {trailer}.
Solid, professional, and one step beyond {trailer}. That is the {winnerClub} way.
The race for the lead has become a race to catch up, and {trailer} is the one doing the running!
Add one more winning season to the pile, and {leader} has something very comfortable to sit on.
If this were a marathon, {leader} would be turning round to wave at {trailer} right about now.
This is a statement season from {leader}, who just widened the gap on the rival!
Breathe, {trailer}. It is a long road still, but {leader} has opened up a serious stretch!
Another victory means another chunk of advantage, and {winnerClub} will take every bit!
No dramatics, no drama, just a clean win and a lead that keeps growing.
Watch that gap, folks. It does not want to close, and {leader} certainly is not helping!
{leader} makes it look easy, and that is the most worrying thing of all for {trailer}.
Smoothly done by {winnerClub}, and the Showdown is a little more settled than before.
A little breathing space is gold in a Showdown, and {leader} has found plenty!
Leaders lead, and {leader} has led from the front again, with {trailer} far behind.
That gap did not just grow, it stretched, and {leader} was holding the tape!
Fresh from a win, {leader} looks every inch the favorite, and {trailer} is the one with questions.
Do not take your eyes off this one. {leader} is on a roll, and the lead is on a roll too!
There is a lead, and then there is a cushion, and then there is whatever {leader} has built here.
Quiet confidence at {winnerClub}, and quiet worry at {loserClub}. That is how leads feel!
A season to remember for {winner}, a season to forget for {loser}, and a Showdown that tilts again.
Think of the lead as a wall, and {leader} just added another row of bricks.
Wasn't this supposed to be tight? {leader} has had other ideas, and then some!
{trailer} will need a big, big season to fix this, because {leader} just got out of reach.
Sit back, {leader}. Well, not too far back. The lead is growing, but the chase is on.
Breaking away from the field, and the field is one manager, and that manager is {trailer}.
Up goes the advantage, up goes the confidence, and up goes the volume in the {winnerClub} dugout!
A big step closer to something special for {leader}, and a big step further away for {trailer}.
Not one, but two in a row for the lead to be stretched. Impressive from {leader}!
It is a lead you can feel from the other side of the room.
Cold, clear, and calculated. {leader} extends the lead, and the Showdown leans the same way.
Watching {leader} win this season is like watching a train pick up speed on a long straight!
One more for {winnerClub}, and what once looked like a race looks more like a procession of one.
Look how far {leader} has traveled, and look how far there is still to go for {trailer}.
Season {season} adds to the legend, and {leader} adds to the gap!
